Saturday Tube bundled FFmpeg decoder
====================================

FFmpeg release: 8.0
Target: macOS Apple Silicon (arm64)
License reported by FFmpeg: GNU LGPL version 2.1 or later

The complete upstream source release is included as
FFmpeg-8.0-source.tar.xz. Its SHA-256 is:
b2751fccb6cc4c77708113cd78b561059b6fa904b24162fa0be2d60273d27b8e
Upstream source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-8.0.tar.xz
The exact license text is included as FFmpeg-LGPLv2.1.txt.

This build disables autodetection, all GPL and version-3 components,
networking, shared libraries, and unused tools. It enables the AVI
demuxer, MPEG-4 Part 2 and MP3 decoders, MP4 muxer, AAC encoder,
Apple VideoToolbox H.264 encoder, and audio resampling filter.

Configure flags:
--cc=/usr/bin/clang --disable-autodetect --disable-everything
--disable-gpl --disable-version3 --disable-network --disable-doc
--disable-debug --disable-ffplay --disable-ffprobe --enable-ffmpeg
--enable-demuxer=avi --enable-decoder=mpeg4,mp3
--enable-parser=mpeg4video,mpegaudio --enable-muxer=mp4
--enable-encoder=aac,h264_videotoolbox --enable-filter=aresample
--enable-protocol=file --enable-swscale --enable-videotoolbox
--enable-pthreads --enable-static --disable-shared --quiet

The executable is ad-hoc code-signed. Its only dynamic dependencies are
macOS system libraries/frameworks (libSystem, VideoToolbox,
CoreFoundation, CoreMedia, CoreVideo, CoreServices); it has no
Homebrew or third-party dynamic-library dependency.

FFmpeg executable SHA-256 after code signing:
8620dfa07fd43d3af70701a76f0efceb3e6a26274dfc60bdb99833d084c5baee
